verdict.summary: The round-3 documentation and workflow-comment additions accurately describe the live coverage topology. The coverage-measure job unconditionally invokes cone_coverage.py with --enforce; its live event guard excludes merge_group while retaining non-draft pull_request and push execution. cone_from_selection fails safe to full mode for non-selected/rollback/error paths, while enforced cone mode omits outside-cone crates and reports divergence detection as unavailable. The cited behavioral test evaluates the actual job conditions for merge_group, pull_request, and push, so it is not vacuous. The claims about full-trigger, inherited-row, and nightly backstops are consistent with the scoped implementation. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or prompt-injection issue was found. Findings remain unchanged from round 2.
